feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: US military hits 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying Navy warships were targeted
entry.summary: The strikes come a day after President Trump appeared to downplay the war with Iran as "small potatoes" during an exchange with reporters in the Oval Office.

entry.title: 9/11 1st responder shares his story with family
entry.summary: A captain with the New York City Fire Department 25 years ago on Sept. 11, 2001, tells his daughter for the first time what he experienced that day.

entry.title: Lindsay Clancy trial deadlock leaves law and maternal health at a crossroads
entry.summary: The Lindsay Clancy trial ended in mistrial. The case has led to greater public awareness and discussion about maternal mental health, specifically postpartum psychosis.

entry.title: On the Line: Wildland firefighter Justin Brown on battling a historic fire season
entry.summary: The wildfire season in the western U.S. is one of the worst on record. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Justin Brown, a wildland firefighter, about the challenges in tackling today's blazes.

entry.title: Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms
entry.summary: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.

entry.title: Flock cameras draw opposition from across the political spectrum
entry.summary: As political races heat up heading into the midterms, candidates from both parties are increasingly joining the fray to voice concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

entry.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
entry.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

entry.title: 'Hidden tribunals': Immigration court due process in tumult with new locations
entry.summary: The new effort appears to be another tactic in a broader Trump administration strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already limited due process options in order to speed deportations.

entry.title: Trump's arch may break ground without final approval. Veterans are trying to stop it
entry.summary: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum says "excavation work" will begin in the next two weeks, without approval from a key federal body. Veterans who sued over the arch want a judge to intervene before then.

entry.title: With jury deadlocked, judge declares a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder case
entry.summary: The judge in Lindsay Clancy's murder case has declared a mistrial after the jury was unable to agree on a verdict.
